name: Houjou Ayano
source:
Hobbies: Cooking, cleaning, eating
Skills: Foreign cuisine, perfect cleaning
Favorite food: Onigiri

The daughter of the owner of a major restaurant chain which has gained tremendous popularity all over the world, with her father making quite a tremendous fortune. A bright and honest girl who is friendly towards anyone and ready to help people no matter who they are. Ayano has been training herself in "wife-like chores" such as cooking and cleaning, because she believes that her prince will appear some day. Her biggest weaknesses are being hungry and studying.

Because of a certain event in her past where she forgot to wear panties one day, her masochistic and exhibitionist side saw light for the first day. She likes being ordered around by Chiaki, but at the same time it seems like she's hiding something...

[spoiler] She belongs to the Kisaragi family and eventually sometime after her parents pass away from an accident, she was adopted by the Houjou family and hidden away while treating her as a maid. Her real name is Kisaragi Aya 如月 亜弥

She eventually returns to the Kisaragi family some time later and has become the successor of her own family as her identity is revealed. [/spoiler]
